mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_turn (turn_id, session_id, seq, user_input, state_before, status) VALUES (#{turnId}, #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{userInput}, CAST(#{stateBeforeJson} AS jsonb), 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_turn SET final_reply = #{finalReply}, route_action = #{routeAction}, route_target = #{routeTarget}, node_path = CAST(#{nodePathJson} AS jsonb), state_after = CAST(#{stateAfterJson} AS jsonb), status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, finished_at = now() WHERE turn_id = #{turnId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_node_exec (exec_id, turn_id, session_id, seq, node_id, node_type, input_state, status) VALUES (#{execId}, #{turnId}, #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeType}, CAST(#{inputStateJson} AS jsonb), 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_node_exec SET output_update = CAST(#{outputUpdateJson} AS jsonb), status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, finished_at = now() WHERE exec_id = #{execId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_llm_call (call_id, turn_id, session_id, exec_id, node_id, purpose, provider, model_name, streaming, request_body, status) VALUES (#{callId}, #{turnId}, #{sessionId}, #{execId}, #{nodeId}, #{purpose}, #{provider}, #{modelName}, #{streaming}, CAST(#{requestBodyJson} AS jsonb), 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_llm_call SET response_body = CAST(#{responseBodyJson} AS jsonb), response_text = #{responseText}, input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, finish_reason = #{finishReason}, status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, finished_at = now() WHERE call_id = #{callId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_tool_call (tool_call_id, turn_id, session_id, exec_id, llm_call_id, node_id, tool_name, arguments, status) VALUES (#{toolCallId}, #{turnId}, #{sessionId}, #{execId}, #{llmCallId}, #{nodeId}, #{toolName}, CAST(#{argumentsJson} AS jsonb), 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_tool_call SET result = #{result}, status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, finished_at = now() WHERE tool_call_id = #{toolCallId}
mapper.select: SELECT turn_id, tool_name, arguments::text AS arguments, result FROM flow_tool_call WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND tool_name <> 'ask_user' AND turn_id IN #{tid} ORDER BY started_at

SELECT turn_id, seq, user_input, final_reply, route_action, route_target, node_path::text AS node_path, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_turn WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY seq

SELECT turn_id, session_id, seq, user_input, final_reply, route_action, route_target, node_path::text AS node_path, state_before::text AS state_before, state_after::text AS state_after, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_turn WHERE turn_id = #{turnId}

SELECT exec_id, seq, node_id, node_type, input_state::text AS input_state, output_update::text AS output_update, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_node_exec WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} ORDER BY seq

SELECT call_id, exec_id, node_id, purpose, provider, model_name, streaming, request_body::text AS request_body, response_body::text AS response_body, response_text, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, finish_reason, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_llm_call WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} ORDER BY started_at

SELECT tool_call_id, exec_id, llm_call_id, node_id, tool_name, arguments::text AS arguments, result, status, error_msg, latency_ms, started_at FROM flow_tool_call WHERE turn_id = #{turnId} ORDER BY started_at
